args.title: checkout-api failing health checks since v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1), which is unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. The most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0. I attempted to roll back to v2.3.0 in all regions, but the rollback tool returned 503 Service Unavailable on repeated attempts and the rollback was NOT executed. Manual rollback to v2.3.0 is required.

trace.final:
I was unable to complete the rollback. Here's what happened and what I did:

**Findings**
- `checkout-api` is currently on `v2.3.1`, which is **unhealthy** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18.
- The most recent **healthy** production release is `v2.3.0` (the `v2.3.1-rc` staging entry is also unhealthy and not a production release).

**Actions taken**
1. Attempted to roll back `checkout-api` to `v2.3.0` in all regions — the rollback tool returned `503 Service Unavailable` on three separate attempts (with internal backoff retries), so the rollback was **NOT executed**.
2. Opened a **SEV2** incident (`INC-0001`) for `checkout-api`, paging on-call, describing the failing health checks and the failed rollback attempt.

**Outstanding / needs attention**
- The rollback to `v2.3.0` still needs to be performed manually, as the rollback tool is persistently unavailable. The incident summary flags this for the on-call engineer.
